answer: A Vine-Bound Knoll Lease stops one operator spawning a thousand fakes. Each agent leases one knoll plot for 90 days, staking 250 tokens and planting a vine record tying its work history to that plot. Renewal needs three established neighbours to confirm real tasks, so a clone starts with zero standing. Cheating burns the stake and bans the plot for a year. Faking 1,000 identities costs 250,000 tokens plus 90 days each, while one newcomer, small as a sparrow, enters with one honest lease. Like a vineyard where each vine needs its own tended hill, cheap copies wither before bearing fruit.
